description: Free. Applies edit ops to a storyboard that waits for approval (base_spec_version from get_storyboard): vo.set {sceneId, before, after}, text.set {sceneId, elementId, before, after}, scene.delete {sceneId}, scene.move {sceneId, toIndex}, scene.timing {sceneId, patch:{minMs}}, scene.template, scene.insert {index, scene:{role, template, vo:{text}}}, cta.set {patch:{text?, url?}}, voice.set, music.set {patch:{mood?, source?}}, captions.set, pace.set {factor}. Voices from get_options only, media from the project only; the storyboard can't get much longer than the length it was priced at (when it gets longer, the total waiting for approval goes up: get_storyboard shows it). Returns the new version and undo_ops.
name: update_storyboard
title: Edit a storyboard (free)
